records.title: Redevelopment of Dilapidated Quarters
details: a to d: It is planned to redevelop the colony. The work of redevelopment of the colony has been entrusted to Rail Land Development Authority (RLDA). Part of the colony land will be utilized for construction of multistorey quarters and balance land will be utilized for commercial development to generate non-fare revenue.

records.title: Pathetic Condition of BSNL's Mobile Network
details:
a to b: To further improve the network condition in Sultanpur, BSNL has planned to upgrade its
mobile network with 99 new indigenous 4G BTSs, out of which 44 number of 4G BTSs are already
ON-Air.

records.title: Double passports through Fraudulent means
details: (c) During the last four months, one complaint has been received by the Regional Passport Office (RPO), Lucknow, from a Member of Parliament on which the Uttar Pradesh Police Authorities have been requested to investigate and inform the RPO about the outcome of the investigation. Suitability of the proposed space from technical side is being examined.

records.title: Physiotherapists In Government Hospitals
details: (c) & (d): In respect of the newly created post in Kalawati Saran Hospital under Lady Hardinge Medical College, it is informed that a newly created post is filled up after framing of Recruitment Rules for the post.
